_what: THE SOURCE OF TRUTH behind this door's visible capability table. Completion-plan item 22 (P0). capability.json holds the nine rows the reader sees; this file holds the machine record for the same nine capabilities, one entry each, in the same order. tools/build-capability-manifest.js REFUSES to run unless every row here matches the visible table's question and status character for character, so the registry can never claim something the page does not, and the page can never claim something the registry does not.
_not_rendered: build.js does not read this file. Nothing in it reaches the page. It is read only by tools/build-capability-manifest.js, which writes assets/capabilities/home-problem-analyzer.json. Not one visible character of the door page changes because this file exists.
_live_status_is_the_dangerous_field: Completion-plan item 22 ends: 'A06 must fail a page that claims a capability that is not live.' Nobody has yet run these nine capabilities against the production runtime, and the trial build is documented as running on deterministic stand-ins with no model wired (Project/03 Build/PRN Trial Build State 2026-08-20.md). So every row below is CLAIMED_ON_PAGE_PENDING_RUNTIME_VERIFICATION. That is not pessimism, it is the only honest value available today. Flipping a row to LIVE is a human act backed by a runtime test, not an edit made because the page reads well. Do not bulk-set this field.

_status_vocabulary._note: The six truthful boundary statuses from completion-plan item 22. This page uses five of them; NOT SAFE TO DETERMINE REMOTELY appears nowhere in the built page and is therefore claimed by no row here.
_status_vocabulary.CAN ANSWER: The tool settles the question outright from what the homeowner can safely give it.
_status_vocabulary.CAN OFTEN ANSWER: Usually settled from one piece of evidence; not guaranteed for every system or photo.
_status_vocabulary.CAN ANSWER WHAT IT CHANGES: The tool cannot name the cause, but it can say what this observation changes about the next step.
_status_vocabulary.CAN NARROW: The tool rules branches out; it does not close the question on its own.
_status_vocabulary.STILL NEEDS TESTING: The tool organises the evidence and shifts likelihood. Confirmation needs a licensed measurement on site.
_status_vocabulary.NOT SAFE TO DETERMINE REMOTELY: UNUSED ON THIS PAGE. Reserved for questions where attempting a remote answer would itself be unsafe.

problem_family.label: AC blowing warm air
problem_family._source: spec/ac-blowing-warm-air/crumb.json — the breadcrumb the page renders and mirrors into its BreadcrumbList.

safety_boundaries._source: spec/ac-blowing-warm-air/safe_observations.json, verbatim. These are the page's own words to the homeowner, not a paraphrase.
never: Open an electrical compartment or test a live circuit
Touch a capacitor. They hold a charge with the power off
Add refrigerant or open any sealed part
Take a panel off the indoor or outdoor unit
stop_and_call_now: You smell burning, see smoke or see sparking. Cut power at the breaker first
The breaker trips again after you reset it once
Water is pooling near anything electrical
The heat is dangerous for an infant, an older adult, or someone unwell

limitations: Cannot take an electrical measurement. Confirming a capacitor or contactor needs a licensed technician on site.
Cannot measure refrigerant pressures. The page's words: pressures cannot be measured down a phone line.
Cannot open, or ask a homeowner to open, any sealed or electrical panel.
Does not dispatch, quote or perform work. It produces a packet the homeowner carries to whichever provider they choose.
Reads an equipment label from a photo only when the label is legible; an unreadable label is reported as unread, never guessed.
